items.t: Gulf Coast Traffic Alerts: October 28
items.x: Here are your traffic alerts for Wednesday, October 28.

items.t: Cooper Pratt sets World Series record
items.x: Cooper Pratt has made World Series history. He has had six straight hits while at bat, the most of any rookie in history for the championship game.

items.t: NFL players help build mobility ramp for veteran in need
items.x: NFL players and members of the Cincinnati Bengals teamed up with Operation Ramp It Up volunteers to help give one Cincinnati veteran a better quality of life.

items.t: Smoke from LA fires exposed millions of people to high levels of toxic heavy metals, study says
items.x: A new study reveals that at the height of the Los Angeles fires in 2025, millions of residents were exposed in a 24-hour period to toxic lead levels from smoke that were 80 times higher than the typical background level.

items.t: Rain chances linger into Halloween weekend
items.x: It will be another windy day with scattered showers for the Gulf Coast.

items.t: Defeated Brazilian presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro and his family land in Miami
items.x: n Miami after fleeing Brazil.

items.t: Judge denies federal request to segregate California ballots, says it would 'wreak havoc' on voting
items.x: A federal judge has rejected a Trump administration request to stop California from processing the ballots of up to 20,000 people, warning it would “wreak havoc” on the midterm elections.

items.t: Alvin K. Hellerstein, a federal judge who handled Trump, Maduro and 9/11 cases, dies at 92
items.x: Alvin K. Hellerstein, a Manhattan federal judge who presided over matters involving President Trump, former Venezuelan President Maduro and the 9/11 attacks, has died.

items.t: Comisión de Ética de Florida desestima queja contra sheriff de Lee Carmine Marceno
items.x: Florida desestimó la queja ética contra Carmine Marceno en Lee County y no halló causa probable por regalos ni abuso del cargo.

items.t: US warns allies to prepare for possible Iran strikes, retaliation after elections, AP sources say
items.x: U.S. officials have told several Middle East countries and regional allies to be prepared for potential military action against Iran after next week’s midterms.

items.t: TV personality Ernie Johnson says this will be final season on 'Inside the NBA'
items.x: Ernie Johnson, the longtime television personality and sportscaster, announced Wednesday that this will be his final season hosting "Inside the NBA."

items.t: Cornell faculty to move forward with no-confidence vote over handling of sexual assault allegations
items.x: Cornell faculty members are now moving forward with an electronic vote on a proposed no-confidence resolution in the university’s administration, with voting set to conclude Nov. 6.

items.t: Cape Coral's first Costco could bring up to 175 jobs as council weighs $10M incentive deal
items.x: Cape Coral is set to open its first Costco, creating up to 175 jobs and offering residents a closer shopping option through a $10 million incentive deal.

items.t: As AI in politics becomes more common, here's how voters can stay vigilant
items.x: Experts say voters cannot rely on visual clues alone to spot fake election content.

items.t: Viewer question: Will La Niña return next hurricane season?
items.x: Does the very strong El Niño we're in right now mean a very strong La Niña is next?

items.t: Police in South Carolina close Hayden Panettiere death investigation with no charges
items.x: The investigation into the death of Hayden Panettiere has been closed by police in Greenville, South Carolina

items.t: ‘It’s big’: Astronomers make startling discovery of a possible dwarf planet beyond Pluto
items.x: Astronomers using the world's largest telescope have spotted a new dwarf planet candidate in our solar system, beyond the orbit of Pluto.

items.t: Man accused of hit-and-run on Cape Coral canal marker that caused $1,000 in damage
items.x: A man was arrested after officers with the Cape Coral Police Department say he hit a canal marker and drove away.

items.t: Young entrepreneur gives Cape Coral single mom a free car detail, finds his purpose
items.x: A 20-year-old entrepreneur gives one free car detail a month, including for a Cape Coral single mom whose son has autism, and says helping others is his purpose.

items.t: Wendy's, struggling with beef prices and growing competition, gets a buyout offer
items.x: Wendy’s shares jumped more than 14% on Wednesday after a noted investor made an offer to buy the chain, which has been struggling with high beef prices, aging stores.
